responses.text: Sorry, you just win too much. We can't let you play here anymore.
Welcome to Vikki and Vance, we're still getting the casino up and running but feel free to sit down and play.
We're hoping that Primm will get back on its feet from the money we earn here.
We feel much safer opening the casino back up, now that we have a sheriff.
I'm glad that I could start working here again, things were rough with those convicts in town.
